Apple___Apple_scab.description: Causes olive-green to black velvety spots on leaves and fruit, leading to premature leaf drop.

organic: Apply sulfur or copper-based sprays early season
Prune tree canopy for air circulation
chemical: Use Difenoconazole at green tip stage

Apple___Black_rot.description: Produces frog-eye leaf spots and cankers on branches, causing dark rotted areas on fruit.

organic: Prune out dead wood and cankers 6 inches below visible damage
chemical: Apply Thiophanate-methyl or Captan from petal fall through harvest
preventive: Control insect damage that creates wounds

Apple___healthy.description: Leaf tissues exhibit uniform pigmentation and no pathogenic infection.

preventive: Regular field scouting and balanced irrigation

Tomato___Late_blight.description: Causes large, irregular dark water-soaked lesions on leaves and white fungal growth on undersides.

organic: Destroy and discard infected plants immediately
preventive: Water only at base using drip irrigation

Tomato___healthy.description: Vibrant green foliage showing no chlorosis or necrosis.

organic: Apply neem oil spray periodically as a general prophylactic
preventive: Ensure proper staking and crop rotation
